author: ViceTechnicolour
body:
I made a Volcano: Remastered with a cut of land from the original volcano but it was not good enough. This, however, is better and has been added for continued DTC testing. I am presenting my map Volcano: Turmoil.




Yeah, it's also pretty massive.
